callees.name: _phase_plan_complete
callees.post_condition: Returns True if and only if phases.json exists at its expected path under work_dir and contains a valid phases plan

callees.name: _domain_context_complete
callees.post_condition: Returns True if and only if engine_overview.txt exists at its expected path under work_dir and, for every phase number P defined in the current phases.json, a corresponding phase_P_types.txt exists at its expected path under work_dir
